testSource:
test('the control reflects the final state after two quick toggles', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/')
  await expect(page.getByTestId('task-2-complete')).not.toBeChecked()
  await toggle(page, 2)
  await toggle(page, 2)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('task-2-complete')).toBeChecked()
})
